definition: Similarity learning is an area of supervised machine learning in artificial intelligence.
details: It is closely related to regression and classification, but the goal is to learn a similarity function that measures how similar or related two objects are. It has applications in ranking, in recommendation systems, visual identity tracking, face verification, and speaker verification.
